gen-flavors-gf-kufam: Flavors is whimsical and loud, with diagonals as hefty as its stems and a stubby, towering lowercase. Kufam follows in a tube-like line, with open curves and short ascenders, leaving the heading to do the shouting when big and brief.
gen-flavors-gf-lexend: Lexend has outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve, a friendly plain sans with a steady line. And Flavors, whimsical with its stubby towering letters, takes the commanding spot above it, so the page has a shout and a murmur.
gen-flavors-gf-lexend-deca: Those towering, pencil-stub lowercase letters make Flavors unmistakable, with diagonals as hefty as its stems. And Lexend Deca stays unshaded sans-serif beneath, its small-looking capitals and uncurled terminals letting the heading take the attention.
gen-flavors-gf-liter: Liter is modern sans-serif with no stroke contrast at all, tall in the lowercase and wide in its round forms. Flavors brings the whimsy above it, while Liter keeps the text quietly upright underneath.
gen-flavors-gf-mada: Flavors draws every line with a ruler's constant width, whimsical yet commanding, with a towering lowercase to match. Mada's plain sans curves stay open below, quietly lighter.
gen-flavors-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans opens every curve generously and holds a high mean line across each word. Martel Sans against the stencil-flat, whimsical Flavors is a study in loud and quiet, sans-serif text under a heading with swagger.
gen-flavors-gf-michroma: Flat, single-weight linework and a lowercase like a stubby carpenter's pencil give Flavors its whimsical bite. And Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, so a longer run of sans text reads spaced out and tall-bodied.
gen-flavors-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre reads like drawn wire, with a lowercase as sturdy as cast iron capitals. Flavors, whimsical and commanding, sits above it, and the stubby heading letters make the text's lighter sans line feel even more modern.
gen-flavors-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Flavors brings whimsy and command, its diagonals as heavy as its stems under a stubby, towering lowercase. But Mochiy Pop One, a sans with a very large lowercase eye, can be sized up a touch, since its letters hang loose like clothespins.
gen-flavors-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One leaves a wide stretch of blank space between letters, its sizable lowercase drawn with no brush swell. And Flavors, whimsical and commanding, sits over that sans-serif text with its stubby, towering lowercase.
